sentences.text: None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 10.04.1987 passed by Sri P.P. Gupta, Sessions Judge, Aligarh in Criminal Appeal No. 21 of 1987, dismissing appeal and upholding order of conviction and sentence passed by Sri Jagan Nath, Ist Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh dated 10.02.1987 in Criminal Case No. 1835 of 1981,
convicting under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing to undergo one year rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 2000/- and in default of payment of fine, he has to suffer further two months rigorous imprisonment.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
